# Unsurpassed Excellence in   **_Hunter / Jumper_** training & competition

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/621417874edcd23a3f0c750c/7001aac5-b3d0-4df4-8591-32002d57c2de/Remove_background_from_image_keeping_only_the_ver-1784328042962.png)

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/621417874edcd23a3f0c750c/af3321d8-ec83-4f26-b70b-d3e05b98097b/Screenshot+2026-07-17+at+3.59.33%E2%80%AFPM.png)

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/621417874edcd23a3f0c750c/e150c122-31e1-4a7a-a96d-709c3d6354f7/Screenshot+2026-07-19+at+9.12.52%E2%80%AFPM.png)

Our Story

## From a family's seven acres to a nationally renowned show barn

Entry 01

1963

William Clark Craig, a West Point graduate, purchased seven acres near Hobby Horse Farm so his daughters, Phoebe and Lucy, could ride to their lessons. He brought his own riding instructor, Colonel Robins, down from West Point — and Switch Willo Stables was born.

1965

Sixteen-year-old Glenn Johnson arrived with his backyard horse and began showing competitively in the Hunter/Jumper discipline — launching a training career that would come to define the barn for six decades.

Today

The property has grown from a five-stall barn into 21 treed acres with 50 stalls and four arenas. Glenn and Phoebe Johnson still call the original property home, and many of central Texas's top professional riders trace their first lesson back to Switch Willo.

![Glenn Johnson competing at Switch Willo Stables](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/621417874edcd23a3f0c750c/c27dbbf9-15e9-4ca2-a114-5a4e53ff5efc/Screenshot+2025-07-06+at+7.00.44+AM.remini-enhanced.jpg)Glenn Johnson, Head Trainer

## Glenn Johnson





OWNER & TRAINER



Glenn Johnson began riding at Switch Willo in 1965. Early in his career he rode Cricket—an ex-bucking horse—to numerous Grand Prix wins at The American Gold Cup, American Invitational, and Winter Equestrian Festival (Wellington, FL).









[Read More About Glenn](https://switchwillo.com/glennbio)

- ![A smiling woman with gray hair styled in a short, layered cut, wearing turquoise jewelry including earrings and a necklace, standing outdoors with a blurred background of rocks and nature.](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/621417874edcd23a3f0c750c/281a33b9-84bd-4ebe-bd4f-13d4734bedca/Phoebe.jpg)







## Phoebe Johnson





FOUNDER, OWNER & TRAINER



A lifelong love of horses and the hunter jumper sport inspires Phoebe Johnson to provide exceptional training for Switch Willo riders and horses. After she started riding at age 12 at local barn Hobby Horse, her father bought two horses for Phoebe and her sister and purchased the first seven acre parcel of Switch Willo land.









[Read More About Phoebe](https://switchwillo.com/phoebebio)

- ![A smiling man with a beard wearing a black cap and a dark grey polo shirt outdoors.](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/621417874edcd23a3f0c750c/c8fb48fc-2845-4a25-bc1a-96969297c3c2/Edit_this_portrait_slim_down_the_mans_cheeks_a_b-1778625530584.png)







## Kirk Berlin





HEAD TRAINER



Kirk Berlin has been involved with horses for over 40 years. When he moved to Austin to attend college, he rode at Switch Willo as an amateur. Upon completing his education he chose to stay on at SWS and turn professional.









[Read More About Kirk](https://www.switchwillo.com/kirkbio)

- ![A smiling woman with long, blonde hair wearing a gray sweatshirt with red lettering standing outdoors.](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/621417874edcd23a3f0c750c/058c5515-4309-4a0a-8ed0-2155109f6612/Edit_this_portrait_replace_the_gray_SWS_sweatshir-1778624354943.png)







## Cindi Wallace





BARN MANAGER



Cindi Wallace has been riding horses for the past 25 years and joined the Switch Willo family in 2008 as a boarder with her horse Pendleton.









[Read More About Cindi](https://switchwillo.com/cindibio)

- ![A smiling woman with short gray hair, glasses, wearing a maroon polo shirt with a logo on the chest, standing outdoors with green foliage in the background.](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/621417874edcd23a3f0c750c/d7ec0003-6c05-434a-93aa-000b7ba236ab/Holly.jpg)







## Holly Mortimer





LESSON DIRECTOR



Holly Mortimer started at Switch Willow Stables, and has been involved in the hunter/jumper world for at least 25 years, managing show offices of many of the Centex and Greater Houston shows.









[Read More About Holly](https://switchwillo.com/hollybio)

- ![A woman with long blond hair smiling outdoors, wearing a gray jacket with a colorful logo on the chest, and a blue patterned shirt underneath.](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/621417874edcd23a3f0c750c/4e851a01-7db9-46fe-b41a-c67c1ecc5e26/Edit_the_sweatshirt_text_in_this_image_change_the-1778124633986.png)







## Riley Wooding





SWITCH WILLO CAMP DIRECTOR



Riley brings a lifelong love of horse camp, along with a deep passion for mentorship to her role here at Camp Switch Willo. A lifelong rider herself, she grew up attending both day camps and sleepaway camps before later working as a wrangler and helping with the care and management of horse herds.









[Read More About Riley](https://switchwillo.com/rileybio)

- ![Older woman smiling outdoors, wearing a red cap, glasses, and a plaid button-up shirt.](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/621417874edcd23a3f0c750c/00750e82-6825-437b-bf4e-68ff06b58359/Bev.jpg)







## Beverly Manroe





TRAINER



Beverly Manroe began her long career at age nine in Houston at a hunter/jumper barn called Parish Stables. She took lessons there for several years and became good enough so that when Mr. Parish left town, he’d put her in charge of teaching as well.









[Read More About Beverly](https://switchwillo.com/beverlybio)

- ![A young woman with long blonde hair smiling outdoors, wearing a gray sweatshirt with red embroidered text.](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/621417874edcd23a3f0c750c/72b644fe-b8d3-4d15-b4d7-65ccdf820478/Kylie.jpg)







## Kylie Wiggins





TRAINER & IEA COACH



Kylie Wiggins first entered Switch Willo Stables when she was only 5 years old. Little did she know that this would soon become her home away from home. She began competing at the local shows when she turned 6 and by the time she was in her teens was competing at the 3 foot level.









[Read More About Kylie](https://switchwillo.com/kyliebio)

- ![A woman smiling outdoors in front of autumn foliage, wearing a red fleece jacket.](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/621417874edcd23a3f0c750c/cef208ee-9b8c-4908-ae58-f046c85cd2c9/Natalie.jpg)







## Natalie Pape





TRAINER



Natalie graduated with a degree in equine studies and participated on their Varsity IHSA team. She has been riding for over 25 plus years. Natalie spent 5 years in Houston where she was able to train, compete and teach students of all levels at Fort Bend Equestrian Center.









[Read More About Natalie](https://switchwillo.com/nataliebio)

- ![A woman with blonde hair wearing a gray jacket with a colorful logo on the chest, outdoors with a blurred background.](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/621417874edcd23a3f0c750c/edee506f-7be7-4022-8e09-41eef5cd1809/Wendy.jpg)







## Wendy Kratzer





TRAINER



Wendy grew up with horses and competed in 4-H and local shows in southern Michigan. At Ball State University she joined the IHSA equestrian team under Coach Mindy McMinn (later Darst) and had a blast rolling around central Indiana and Ohio in the team’s elderly RV.









[Read More About Wendy](https://switchwillo.com/wendybio)

Meet the Switch Willo Team!

  • Glenn Johnson

    OWNER & TRAINER

    Glenn Johnson began riding at Switch Willo in 1965. Early in his career he rode Cricket—an ex-bucking horse—to numerous Grand Prix wins at The American Gold Cup, American Invitational, and Winter Equestrian Festival (Wellington, FL).

    Read More About Glenn

  • Phoebe Johnson

    FOUNDER, OWNER & TRAINER

    A lifelong love of horses and the hunter jumper sport inspires Phoebe Johnson to provide exceptional training for Switch Willo riders and horses. After she started riding at age 12 at local barn Hobby Horse, her father bought two horses for Phoebe and her sister and purchased the first seven acre parcel of Switch Willo land.

    Read More About Phoebe

  • Kirk Berlin

    HEAD TRAINER

    Kirk Berlin has been involved with horses for over 40 years. When he moved to Austin to attend college, he rode at Switch Willo as an amateur. Upon completing his education he chose to stay on at SWS and turn professional.

    Read More About Kirk

  • Cindi Wallace

    BARN MANAGER

    Cindi Wallace has been riding horses for the past 25 years and joined the Switch Willo family in 2008 as a boarder with her horse Pendleton.

    Read More About Cindi

  • Holly Mortimer

    LESSON DIRECTOR

    Holly Mortimer started at Switch Willow Stables, and has been involved in the hunter/jumper world for at least 25 years, managing show offices of many of the Centex and Greater Houston shows. 

    Read More About Holly

  • Riley Wooding

    SWITCH WILLO CAMP DIRECTOR

    Riley brings a lifelong love of horse camp, along with a deep passion for mentorship to her role here at Camp Switch Willo. A lifelong rider herself, she grew up attending both day camps and sleepaway camps before later working as a wrangler and helping with the care and management of horse herds.

    Read More About Riley

  • Beverly Manroe

    TRAINER

    Beverly Manroe began her long career at age nine in Houston at a hunter/jumper barn called Parish Stables. She took lessons there for several years and became good enough so that when Mr. Parish left town, he’d put her in charge of teaching as well.

    Read More About Beverly

  • Kylie Wiggins

    TRAINER & IEA COACH

    Kylie Wiggins first entered Switch Willo Stables when she was only 5 years old. Little did she know that this would soon become her home away from home. She began competing at the local shows when she turned 6 and by the time she was in her teens was competing at the 3 foot level.

    Read More About Kylie

  • Natalie Pape

    TRAINER

    Natalie graduated with a degree in equine studies and participated on their Varsity IHSA team. She has been riding for over 25 plus years. Natalie spent 5 years in Houston where she was able to train, compete and teach students of all levels at Fort Bend Equestrian Center.

    Read More About Natalie

  • Wendy Kratzer

    TRAINER

    Wendy grew up with horses and competed in 4-H and local shows in southern Michigan. At Ball State University she joined the IHSA equestrian team under Coach Mindy McMinn (later Darst) and had a blast rolling around central Indiana and Ohio in the team’s elderly RV.

    Read More About Wendy
